title: Where does the Sun go at night?
examples: Teacher, if the Earth turns, does that mean the Sun moves?
When it is dark, is the Sun really gone?
How does the Earth spinning make day and night?

explain.say: The Earth is a big ball that spins around.

draw.text: Where does the Sun go at night?

explain.say: This spinning is called rotation, and it takes one whole day.
When your part of Earth faces the Sun, you get bright daylight.
As the Earth keeps spinning, your part turns away from the Sun.
The other side of Earth that is turning into view has the Sun shining there.
At night, the Sun does not go anywhere, it is just on the other side.

draw.text: Sun is on the other side

faq.q: If the Earth spins, does the Sun also spin?
faq.a: No, the Sun stays in the sky while the Earth spins underneath it. It is the Earth that is moving.
asks: Does the Sun move across the sky?
Is the Sun spinning with the Earth?

faq.q: Why do we have day and night if the Sun is always there?
faq.a: We have day and night because the Earth is always turning around. This spinning shows us different parts of the Earth.
asks: What makes it dark at night?
How does the Earth make day and night?

faq.q: Does the Sun ever go completely away?
faq.a: No, the Sun is a star that stays in its place. It just seems to move because we are spinning.

faq.q: Is the Earth spinning faster or slower?
faq.a: The Earth spins at a steady speed all the time. This spinning causes the cycle of day and night.
asks: Does the Earth spin faster in the morning?
Is the Earth's spin speed constant?

faq.q: Does the Moon spinning affect the day and night?
faq.a: No, the Moon spinning does not cause day and night. The spinning of the Earth does that job.
asks: Does the Moon make it dark at night?
What causes the day and night cycle?

facts: The Earth spins on an imaginary line called an axis.
This spinning motion is called rotation.
Rotation causes the cycle of day and night.
The Sun is a star and does not move around the Earth.

quiz.say: What causes the day and night cycle?
quiz.why: The Earth spinning is what causes your part to face the Sun and then turn away.

wrong.1: The Sun is a star and stays in the sky; it does not move to cause night.
wrong.2: The Moon orbits the Earth, but it does not cause the day and night cycle.
wrong.3: The air around Earth does not spin in a way that creates day and night.

quiz.say: When you see the Sun rise, what is happening?
quiz.why: It looks like the Sun rises, but really, the Earth is spinning into the sunlight.

wrong.1: The Sun stays put; it is the Earth that is spinning past the light.
wrong.2: This is what happens, but it is caused by the Earth's rotation, not just the night ending.
wrong.3: The Sun's size does not change to make it appear to rise.

quiz.say: If the Earth stopped spinning, what would happen?
quiz.why: Without spinning, one side would always face the Sun and never turn away.

wrong.0: If it was always night, the Earth would not be facing the Sun at all.
wrong.1: The Sun is far away and its movement is not connected to the Earth stopping.
wrong.3: If it was always day, the Earth would not be turning at all.
